basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/Zscaler%20Private%20Access/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. The [Zscaler Private Access](https://www.zscaler.com/products-and-solutions/zscaler-private-access) solution for Microsoft Sentinel ingests [Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) logs](https://help.zscaler.com/zpa/about-log-streaming-service) into Microsoft Sentinel using Zscaler Cloud NSS push connectors. Supported log types: 1. User Activity 2. User Status 3. App Protection 4. App Connector Status 5. Private Service Edge (PSE) Status All feeds land in the shared **ZPA_CL** table and are surfaced through the included parsers and workbooks. **Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:** 1. [Azure Monitor Logs: DCR-based Custom Logs](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/custom-logs-overview) 2. [Codeless Connector Platform (CCP)](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector) **Data Connectors:** 5, **Parsers:** 5, **Workbooks:** 5 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Zscaler Private Access Cloud NSS User Activity Log Push Connector. You can get Zscaler Private Access Cloud NSS User Activity Log Push Connector data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.
